saw_lines: Face oil and cleanser buyers try one kit item, then reorder it or drift off, so the first order decides the account.
So the sale is won or lost in the opening ad, and yours give a new buyer no offer and no proof.

points: 0 of 19 copy ads carry a proof number, so a cold buyer has nothing to believe. Collect one real figure, a review count or orders shipped, and open the next three ads with it on the creative.
0 of 19 copy ads mention an offer, so new buyers have no reason to act now. Build three ads that open with a first order offer or a bundle on the Olio Denso kit, and test them beside current ads.

15 ads have run 60+ days, yet none of the newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line. Those have lasted longest, so their openings are the safest to copy. Build your next three ads as variations of the oldest winner.

16 different opening stories run across 19 copy ads, and the biggest opens only 2 of them. Each new story makes the ads compete with each other. Pick the two strongest stories and build your next batch from them.
